facts: A deposit is credited after network confirmations (generally 1; Arbitrum One and Base: 12; ETH needs more confirmations than most coins).
Check the record and confirmation progress in transaction history. Pressing Send in your wallet is not the same as the transfer being confirmed.
Minimums differ per coin and network; there is no single figure. Use the minimum and fee shown for the selected coin and network in your wallet.
A coin and a network are separate selections; sending on the wrong network is not fixed by sending another transfer.

Every House Games result is calculated from three inputs fixed before you bet: a server seed committed in advance (only its SHA-256 hash is shown before betting), a client seed you control, and a nonce that counts your bets.
Nothing about a round can change after it starts.

To verify a bet: open the game's Provably fair window, rotate the seed pair the bet was played on (its server seed is revealed), check the SHA-256 hash equals the hash shown before betting, then run the game's function with client seed + nonce. The Verifier tab in the game does the same calculation.
Find a bet: open Transactions from your profile and choose the casino-bet history. For a Tequity Original, clicking the bet also shows its server seed, client seed and nonce.
Both tools are in your account: Profile -> Settings -> Responsible Gaming.
Take a Break applies a 24-hour cooling-off period, during which you cannot play.
Self-exclusion options: 1 week, 1 month, 6 months, or permanently. It cannot be reversed or shortened for any reason once it is active.
If you cannot sign in, e-mail support@housebets.com from your registered address and say you need help self-excluding.
If you have already excluded, support can still help you withdraw any remaining funds.
Independent support organisations: BeGambleAware (begambleaware.org), Gambling Therapy (gamblingtherapy.org), GamTalk (gamtalk.org), the Responsible Gambling Council, Gamblers Anonymous.
Blocking tools: BetBlocker (betblocker.org) and GamBlock; Net Nanny as a filtering option.
Open Rewards to see your VIP progress and the reward amounts available to your account.
Instant rakeback becomes available to claim when eligible play has produced an amount available to claim.
There is no single fixed percentage for every reward; check the rates and terms shown for your account.
A deposit by itself earns nothing; play does.

source: Housebets Help Center (help.housebets.com), fetched 2026-11-23. No sandbox keys or API keys were available, so the agent runs offline from the ticket JSON alone; every fact below is baked in from the Help Center articles listed.

facts: Verification is not a standard step at Housebets; most players are never asked for documents. If asked, you get an e-mail from Housebets with a link, and the same check is inside your account.
Where to do it: sign in, open Profile -> Settings -> Account verification. Select Start verification (or Continue) and follow the prompts.
Documents sent in chat or by e-mail are NOT processed; only the verification flow counts. Never ask for documents in the chat.
Statuses: Started (a step is still waiting), Under review (documents are in, result comes by e-mail), Approved (check complete).

withdrawal_review_window_hours.note: NOT a Help Center figure. The Help Center says withdrawals are normally paid within minutes. The 24-hour review window and the escalate-after-24-hours rule come from the contest's own sample tickets (their rubrics state reviews can take up to 24 hours and escalate after 24 hours). The agent uses 24h as its decision threshold to match the sample ground truth.

facts: Withdrawals are paid out automatically, normally within minutes.

Statuses live in Wallet -> History: Pending (in the payout queue), Completed (transfer sent; the blockchain transaction hash / TXID appears once broadcast, follow it on a block explorer), Rejected / failed / cancelled (amount is back on your balance).
A withdrawal can wait because the payout wallet for that network is being topped up, or because the request needs a manual approval by the team.
A withdrawal can be cancelled only while it is still queued or on hold; once sent to the blockchain it cannot be stopped. Ask support in chat to cancel.
A deposit must be wagered once (1x) before it can be withdrawn.
The ID shown in History is Housebets' internal reference, not the blockchain hash.
